arguments.brief: Build the audit-committee readout for Cobalt Insurance: the FY26 IT general controls (ITGC) and SOX-style assurance review across five domains. 12-14 slides. Facts: scope was 5 domains, 48 key controls, 1,160 samples tested across 9 applications. Results by domain: access management 14 controls, 3 exceptions, rating red; change management 11 controls, 1 exception, amber; computer operations 9 controls, 0 exceptions, green; program development 6 controls, 1 exception, amber; third-party / cloud 8 controls, 2 exceptions, red. Overall opinion: partially effective. Seven findings, each with a severity (2 high, 3 medium, 2 low), an owner and a due date between Dec 2026 and Jun 2027; the two high findings are 'privileged access not recertified for 3 of 9 applications' and 'cloud provider SOC 2 reports not reviewed for 2 of 4 providers'. Testing approach: plan (scoping, risk assessment), walkthroughs, design evaluation, operating-effectiveness testing, reporting. Year-on-year: exceptions 2024: 11, 2025: 9, 2026: 7; high-rated findings 2024: 4, 2025: 3, 2026: 2. Control maturity by domain on a 1-5 scale: access 2, change 3, operations 4, development 3, third-party 2; target 4 everywhere by FY28. Remediation plan: Q4 2026 quick wins (recertification run, SOC 2 review), Q1-Q2 2027 access tooling, Q3 2027 re-test. Management has accepted all seven actions. Ask: the committee notes the opinion and endorses the remediation plan. Required: results-by-domain board with RAG rating visible as colour; the seven-finding register as a table (title, severity, owner, due date); a year-on-year trend chart on the left with the overall opinion as headline on the right; control maturity today vs FY28 target as a ladder; scope and approach as a five-step process; the two high findings each on their own structured slide; the remediation roadmap; an action-titled executive summary; a next-steps closer with the committee ask; detailed testing statistics in an appendix.

content.text_value: High: privileged access was not recertified for 3 of 9 applications

rows.label: WHAT WE FOUND
rows.body: The annual privileged-access recertification was not performed for 3 of the 9 in-scope applications (claims, policy admin, general ledger). 41 privileged accounts went unreviewed in FY26.

rows.label: WHY IT MATTERS
rows.body: Unreviewed privileged accounts can change financial data and configurations without detection. **This is a SOX key control and the main driver of the red rating for access management.**

rows.label: ACTION
rows.body: Run a full recertification of all privileged accounts across the 9 applications in Q4 2026, then move recertification into the access tooling delivered in H1 2027 with quarterly cadence.

rows.label: OWNER AND DATE
rows.body: Head of IAM. Recertification complete by **31 Dec 2026**; tooling live by 30 Jun 2027; Internal Audit re-tests in Q3 2027.

content.text_value: High: SOC 2 reports were not reviewed for 2 of 4 cloud providers

rows.label: WHAT WE FOUND
rows.body: SOC 2 Type II reports for 2 of the 4 cloud providers hosting in-scope applications were obtained but not reviewed; complementary user-entity controls were not mapped for either provider.

rows.label: WHY IT MATTERS
rows.body: Cobalt relies on provider controls for hosting, backup and logical access. **Without review, exceptions at the provider would go unnoticed and the reliance is unsupported.**

rows.label: ACTION
rows.body: Review both outstanding SOC 2 reports, map user-entity controls and log exceptions in Q4 2026; embed an annual review step in the third-party risk procedure.

rows.label: OWNER AND DATE
rows.body: Head of Third-Party Risk. Reviews complete by **31 Dec 2026**; procedure updated by 31 Mar 2027; Internal Audit re-tests in Q3 2027.

slides.title: Access and third-party controls must climb two maturity levels by FY28
insights: Computer operations already meets the level-4 target.
Access and third-party / cloud sit at level 2 and need the biggest step-up.
Change and development need one level each, mostly through evidence discipline.
slides.takeaway: Target: level 4 in every domain by FY28.

slides.title: Remediation runs in three phases and is re-tested in Q3 2027
